cc:Work.dc:title: Native Cerulion on three platforms
cc:Work.dc:description: One panel, six series: multi-process (solid) and single-process (dashed) on Linux x86-64 (blue), Jetson Orin NX (orange) and Apple M4 (violet). Recorder enabled.

g.text: Same payload sweep on three machines · colour = platform, line style = run shape

g.text: STOCK · recorder ON · fixed 100 Hz · k=5

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #53677c

g.text: Commanded 100 Hz; five sessions, 10,000 samples per point. Always-on recording included. Payload fill excluded.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #53677c

g.text: Jetson: NV Power Mode 40 W, governor schedutil, CPU clock capped at 1.4976 GHz (hardware max 1.984 GHz).

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #53677c

g.text: Mac: Cerulion 2.0.0 on macOS 27.2.1, measured 2026-11-13, a later build than the x86-64 and Jetson rows. A multi-process consumer

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #53677c

g.text: wakes on the publish. Multi-process p50 9.04 to 9.83 µs, single-process p50 3.62 to 3.83 µs.
